authors: Streinzer M, Huber W, Spaethe J
title: Body size limits dim-light foraging activity in stingless bees (Apidae: Meliponini)
why: Open-access full text of eight Costa Rican stingless bee species including Paratrigona opaca (n = 6), with eye size, ommatidia count, facet diameter and an eye parameter in Table 1. The fetched page did not show the table values for P. opaca, so the genus value that could stand for P. lineata (rule 3, genus) is not yet logged.
get: open access (J Comp Physiol A 202:643; Table 1 and Fig. 2)

title: Photoreceptor properties and distribution in strictly subterranean African mole-rats (Rodentia, Bathyergidae)
journal: Diploma thesis, Charles University, Faculty of Science (supervisor P. Němec)
why: The English abstract says rhodopsin, S- and L-opsin expression, photoreceptor densities and rod to cone proportions were described in Bathyergus suillus, Georychus capensis, Fukomys damarensis, Cryptomys natalensis and Heliophobius argenteocinereus; the Czech abstract adds that cones are more than 10% of photoreceptors in every species. The thesis PDF (open on the repository) was blocked to the fetch tool, so the per-species values for Cryptomys natalensis are unread.
get: open access, Charles University repository https://dspace.cuni.cz/handle/20.500.11956/31706 (thesis PDF 120024028.pdf)
